claims.claim: The asset matches the requested fixture, box name, dimensions, and parts.
claims.evidence: asset/asset.json declares id wall_01 and kind fixture. asset/model.urdf has one base link and a box named wall, size (0.02, 0.40, 0.06) m. readings.json size_cm is [2, 40, 6], with collision bounds [-0.01, -0.20, 0] to [0.01, 0.20, 0.06] m.

claims.claim: Collision geometry exactly matches the visible wall and preserves face clearance.
claims.evidence: asset/model.urdf visual wall and collision wall have identical size 0.02 0.4 0.06, origin xyz 0 0 0.03, and rpy 0 0 0: zero discrepancy, below the 5 mm clearance requirement. renders/front.png, side.png, top.png, and iso.png show the single thin rectangular wall with no additional parts. readings.json contains only this collision box and no collision meshes. Wall height 0.06 m exceeds the specified 0.05 m cube height by 0.01 m.

claims.claim: Joint travel, moving-part support, and inter-link penetration checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is []; asset/model.urdf contains one link and no joints. There are no moving parts or distinct links that can interpenetrate.

claims.claim: Handle grasping and pulling checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles; readings.json handles is [].

claims.claim: Place-target settling checks are not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets; readings.json place_targets is [].

claims.claim: Free-standing rigid-object settling is not applicable to this fixed fixture.
claims.evidence: request.md specifies a fixture loaded fixed on a table, matching asset/asset.json kind fixture. readings.json gives collision bottom z = 0 m. Free-body stability is not required for this use; no simulator run was necessary.
